# Vendored ha.mr baseline

This directory contains the unmodified codec and alphabets from
[`p2r3/ha.mr`](https://github.com/p2r3/ha.mr). The exact commit and SHA-256 digest of every
vendored file are recorded in `manifest.json`.

The benchmark imports these files directly. Do not patch them: a source change must be
recorded as a new baseline revision so old reports remain reproducible.
